title: Derived global sections preserves ambient quasi-coherent coproducts
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $D(\mathcal O_X)$ and its full quasi-coherent subcategory be as in [def-pc-derived-category], and let $G=R\Gamma(X,-)$ be the module-valued unbounded derived global-sections functor [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. For any set-indexed family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ of quasi-coherent derived objects and an ambient colimiting cofan $(S,\iota_i)$, the cofan $(G(S),G(\iota_i))$ is colimiting in $D(\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X))$.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Let a:X → Spec(ULift ℤ) be the structure morphism. It is quasi-compact and quasi-separated because X is qcqs and the target is affine. By [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-direct-sums], Ra_* preserves the ambient coproduct of the E_i. Its terms are quasi-coherent by [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh].

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: The equivalence [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] computes RΓ on Spec(ULift ℤ) by module complexes, and preserves coproducts. Global sections after Ra_* compute RΓ(X,-): underived global sections after a_* are global sections on X with scalar action restricted to ℤ, and K-injective resolutions compute both derived functors as in [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] and [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. The coproduct comparison after restricting scalars to ULift ℤ is therefore invertible. Exact restriction of scalars forms module sums on the underlying additive groups and detects quasi-isomorphisms, hence reflects the invertibility of the derived coproduct comparison. The original comparison over Γ(X,O_X) is invertible, yielding the asserted colimiting cofan. This step stops before taking homology.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedGlobalSections_preserves_coproducts (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
    let G := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∀ (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
      (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S),
      IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι) →
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (G.obj S) (fun i ↦ G.map (ι i))))
